boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain D'Youville University
boards.description: Explore the essential late-night destinations for D'Youville University students, from on-campus study hubs and fitness centers to iconic Buffalo eateries that stay open long after the sun sets.

cards.title: Kuhrt Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Saints Center
cards.notes: Located in the Saints Center, this food court is the primary on-campus spot for dinner and evening socializing before late study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus dining hub for students in the Saints Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Kuhrt Dining Hall is located in the Saints Center and serves as a primary dining location for students.
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner during the academic year; check seasonal hours for specific closing times.

cards.title: D'Youville Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Academic Center
cards.notes: Open until 10:00 PM on weekdays, this facility allows students to squeeze in a late-night workout on the 6th floor or in the basement.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level campus fitness facility open late for student wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center is open Monday through Friday from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Monday-Friday; requires valid student ID for entry.

cards.title: Jim's Steakout
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Village
cards.notes: A Buffalo staple famous for the Stinger sub, this location stays open until 4:00 AM on weekends for the ultimate late-night meal.
cards.short_summary: Iconic Buffalo sub shop known for late-night service and signature steak subs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elmwood Village location is open until 4:00 AM Thursday through Saturday and 2:00 AM Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:00 AM on weekends; walk-in orders accepted until closing.

cards.title: Mighty Taco
cards.subtitle: Delaware Ave
cards.notes: A regional favorite for quick Mexican-style fare, serving the campus community with late-night tacos and burritos.
cards.short_summary: Buffalo's homegrown taco chain and a frequent late-night stop for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Mighty Taco is a Buffalo institution known for catering to late-night crowds since 1973.
cards.access_notes: Check specific location for daily late-night hours; typically open past midnight.

cards.title: Kavinoky Theatre
cards.subtitle: Porter Ave
cards.notes: This professional theatre on campus hosts evening performances and post-show discussions that extend into the night.
cards.short_summary: An intimate professional theatre located on the D'Youville campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kavinoky Theatre hosts evening performances at 7:30 PM with post-show discussions on selected nights.
cards.source_title: A Night with Janis Joplin — D'Youville Kavinoky Theatre
cards.access_notes: Evening showtimes typically start at 7:30 PM; check schedule for specific event dates.

cards.title: Elmwood Taco and Subs (ETS)
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Ave
cards.notes: Known as ETS, this local favorite is open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays for tacos and Buffalo-style subs.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night spot for Mexican fare and subs in the Elmwood Village.
cards.evidence_claim: ETS is open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Montante Family Library
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Campus
cards.notes: The primary research and study hub on campus, offering quiet spaces and group study rooms for late-night academic work.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library and a key destination for evening study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The library provides study spaces and room reservations for students.
cards.access_notes: Check the university website for current semester hours; typically open late during finals.

cards.title: Wellness Lodge
cards.subtitle: KAB 3rd Floor
cards.notes: A dedicated space for students to relax and reset with evening events like yoga and meditation to de-stress from classes.
cards.short_summary: A campus sanctuary for student relaxation and mental wellness activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Lodge on the 3rd floor of KAB hosts events including yoga and meditation.
cards.access_notes: Check the campus events calendar for evening wellness sessions.

cards.title: Papi Grande's Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Maple Rd
cards.notes: A popular spot for evening dining and social gatherings, offering a variety of Mexican dishes and a lively atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant Mexican restaurant frequently visited by students for evening meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Papi Grande's is open for dinner 7 days a week and offers delivery until 9:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for dinner; delivery and pickup options available late into the evening.

cards.title: Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Saints Center
cards.notes: Located in the Saints Center, this arena provides a high-tech space for late-night gaming and competitive esports practice.
cards.short_summary: The university's dedicated facility for competitive and recreational gaming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Esports Arena is located in the Saints Center, which also houses the athletic program and dining hall.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during scheduled arena hours; check with Student Engagement for late-night access.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student-focused spaces at D'Youville University, from specialized labs and wellness retreats to quiet study nooks and affordable campus entertainment.

cards.title: Collaborative Innovation at The Hive
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Visit this collaborative workspace in the Health Professions Hub designed for students and faculty to ideate and work on interdisciplinary projects together.
cards.short_summary: A modern collaborative workspace located within the Health Professions Hub for innovation and group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hive is described as a collaborative workspace that brings students, faculty, staff, and community members together to ideate and collaborate.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and faculty; located within the Health Professions Hub building.

cards.title: Quiet Reset at the Wellness Lodge
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of KAB for a dedicated relaxation space offering yoga, meditation, and chair massages to help manage academic stress.
cards.short_summary: A student wellness retreat in the Koessler Administration Building providing meditation and relaxation services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Lodge on the 3rd floor of KAB offers events including yoga, meditation, art, and chair massages for students to relax and reset.
cards.access_notes: Located on the 3rd floor of KAB; check university schedule for specific wellness event times.

cards.title: Lower Level Social Hub at Maggie's
cards.subtitle: Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie or snack at this lower-level cafe, which features plenty of tables and outdoor dining for socializing between lab sessions.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining and social spot located in the lower level of the Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Maggie's Café is located in the lower level of the ALT building and offers sandwiches, smoothies, and outdoor dining space.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the elevator in the ALT building; offers both indoor and outdoor seating.

cards.title: Affordable Arts at the Kavinoky
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Take advantage of $5 student tickets to see professional live theatre performances in this historic venue located right on campus.
cards.short_summary: A professional theatre venue on campus offering heavily discounted tickets for D'Youville students.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Youville University students can purchase single tickets for $5 at the Kavinoky Theatre box office with a valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Box office purchase required for student discount; must provide D'Youville ID.

cards.title: Split-Level Workouts at the DAC
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Academic Center
cards.notes: Utilize the split-level gym with weights in the basement and cardio equipment on the 6th floor, featuring modern machines and locker rooms.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary fitness facility, distributed across the basement and 6th floor of the Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center in the DAC has free weights and machines in the basement and cardio equipment on the 6th floor.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 6 AM - 10 PM and weekends 9 AM - 7 PM for the campus community.

cards.title: Focused Study in Montante Library
cards.subtitle: Montante Family Library
cards.notes: Reserve a private study room or group pod online to secure a quiet space with whiteboards and HDMI connectivity for exam prep.
cards.short_summary: Reservable private and group study spaces within the university's main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can reserve study spaces like quiet carrels, group rooms, or study pods through the library's online booking tool.
cards.access_notes: Online reservation recommended; student credentials required for booking.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection in SASE 312
cards.subtitle: School of Arts, Sciences and Education, Room 312
cards.notes: Find a moment of peace in this dedicated interfaith space located on the third floor of the SASE building, open to all traditions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated room for prayer and meditation for students of all faith backgrounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The All Faiths Prayer Room is located in SASE 312 as part of the university's campus ministry resources.
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 312 of the SASE building; open during building hours.

cards.title: On-Demand Support at the Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bauer Family Academic Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Stop by the first floor of BFAC for immediate technology assistance and a space to work where support professionals are readily available.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused student lounge providing IT support and workspace in the Bauer Family Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Lounge, located on the first floor of the Bauer Family Academic Center, is staffed with professionals to assist with classroom technology.
cards.access_notes: Located on the 1st floor of BFAC; walk-in support available.

cards.title: Culinary Learning at D'Lish
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Participate in free cooking classes and learn about medically tailored meals in this state-of-the-art demonstration kitchen.
cards.short_summary: A demonstration kitchen in the Health Professions Hub offering nutrition education and cooking classes.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Lish Demonstration Kitchen offers free cooking classes and is run by the D'Youville Department of Nutrition and Dietetics.
cards.access_notes: Located within the Hub; check the D'Lish schedule for class times.

cards.title: Recreational Breaks in the CC
cards.subtitle: College Center
cards.notes: Unwind between classes in the College Center's game room, which offers recreational equipment and a social atmosphere for students.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated recreational space for students located within the College Center building.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Center holds a swimming pool, gym, fitness center, and a game room, all fully equipped and free to students.
cards.access_notes: Located in the College Center; free access for students with ID.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at D'Youville University, from historic campus landmarks to modern wellness centers and community gardens.

cards.title: Hang Out at The Park
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Visit this 24/7 student lounge to relax in modern booths, meet the campus mascots, or study with friends in a historic setting.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 student lounge and advocacy space located inside the historic Koessler Administration Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park Advocacy center is open 24/7. Providing students with a safe space to speak up about their anxieties, hang out with friends.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for D'Youville students with university ID.

cards.title: Work Out for Free
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Academic Center
cards.notes: Access cardio equipment on the 6th floor or hit the free weights in the basement. Just bring your student ID for entry.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level campus fitness facility offering cardio, weights, and a plyometric studio for the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center, open to all campus community members, has moved to the D'Youville Academic Center. Free weights and machines are located in the basement.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM and weekends 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM for students and staff.

cards.title: Relax at the Wellness Lodge
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Drop in for free yoga, meditation sessions, or chair massages designed to help students de-stress between classes.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus space for holistic health, offering free wellness activities and relaxation areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit the 3rd floor of KAB for events including yoga, meditation, art, chair massages, or to come relax and reset.
cards.access_notes: Available to all D'Youville students during scheduled wellness hours.

cards.title: Visit the Community Garden
cards.subtitle: 222 Connecticut Street
cards.notes: Explore the campus greenhouse and raised beds. It's a peaceful green space where students can learn about urban gardening.
cards.short_summary: A campus community garden and greenhouse providing green space and fresh produce for the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The DYU Campus Community Garden... features raised beds and a greenhouse... The garden is open to all students as a place to learn or simply enjoy green space.
cards.source_title: Urban Farm Day - Gardens Buffalo Niagara
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; specific volunteer hours may apply for harvesting.

cards.title: Study in the Hub Atrium
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Enjoy the natural light and public art in this modern 'main street' space. It's a top spot for collaborative student work.
cards.short_summary: A bright, community-focused atrium featuring public art and collaborative gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium serves as a 'main street' for the building... Public art helps beautify the building and the community.
cards.source_title: D'Youville University - Health Professions Hub - SCUP
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible building with dedicated student and community gathering zones.

cards.title: Play at the Saints Center
cards.subtitle: 329 Porter Avenue
cards.notes: Join intramural sports or use the open gym hours to shoot hoops. Admission is free for students with a valid ID.
cards.short_summary: The home of D'Youville athletics, offering open gym time and intramural sports for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The gymnasium offers open gym and intramurals throughout the academic year. Students and staff receive free admission.
cards.access_notes: Free for students with university ID during scheduled open gym hours.

cards.title: Quiet Time at the Chapel
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Find a moment of peace in this historic chapel or the adjacent all-faiths prayer room, open to all students for reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic on-campus chapel and all-faiths prayer room providing a quiet space for spiritual reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: It's also where you'll find the Sacred Heart Chapel and our all-faiths prayer room.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public for prayer and reflection.

cards.title: Reserve a Private Study Room
cards.subtitle: Montante Family Library
cards.notes: Book a quiet room for group projects or solo study. These spaces are free for students and often include whiteboards.
cards.short_summary: Private and group study rooms available within the campus library for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: If you need specific services like reserving a study room... book at least a day or two in advance.
cards.source_title: How Can Students Reserve Study Space At D Youville Library?
cards.access_notes: Reservable online for current students; library hours typically extend until 10:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Take a Free Cooking Class
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Learn to cook healthy, medically tailored meals at no cost. Classes are led by the Department of Nutrition and Dietetics.
cards.short_summary: A demonstration kitchen offering free nutritional cooking classes to students and the community.
cards.evidence_claim: A demonstration kitchen offering free cooking classes and medically tailored meals to improve nutrition.
cards.access_notes: Free classes available by registration; open to students and the public.

cards.title: Visit the Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: 305 Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Engage with diverse student groups and attend free social events aimed at fostering an equitable campus community.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for social engagement, cultural events, and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Join us to engage, learn, and contribute to a more equitable campus community... Cultural Enrichment Center Office: 305 KAB.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during standard university business hours.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover the best environments for focused work and collaboration across the D'Youville University campus, from high-tech hubs to historic lounges.

cards.title: Library 4th Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Quiet Study at Montante Family Library
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for the most dedicated quiet study environment on campus. Use your ID card to access this floor 24/7 for late-night or early-morning sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 quiet study floor located within the Montante Family Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th floor study spaces of the Montante Family Library are open 24/7 with swipe-card access.
cards.source_title: Annual Security and Fire Safety Report 2021
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with a valid D'Youville ID card.

cards.title: The Hive Collaborative Workspace
cards.subtitle: Innovation Space in the Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Visit the second and third floors of the Hub to find this modern, collaborative workspace. It features flexible furniture and is ideal for group projects and networking.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative co-working and study space located in the Health Professions Hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hive is a collaborative workspace lining the second and third floors of the Health Professions Hub.
cards.source_title: D'Youville Hosts Grand Opening for Health Professions Hub
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The Park Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Lounge in Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Located on the second floor of KAB, this lounge offers booths and tables for studying. It is open 24/7, making it a reliable spot for students at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 student lounge and advocacy center on the second floor of KAB.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park Advocacy Center is open 24/7 and provides students with a safe space to hang out and study on the second floor of KAB.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for all D'Youville students.

cards.title: The Beach Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Second Floor Lounge in KAB
cards.notes: Find this student experience home base on the second floor of the Koessler Administration Building. It serves as a casual lounge area for quick study sessions between classes.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge and home base for Student Experience on the second floor of KAB.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach is a student lounge and the home base of Student Experience on the second floor of KAB.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during standard building hours.

cards.title: Joan of Arc Hall Study Space
cards.subtitle: Connector Space Between BFAC and KAB
cards.notes: Use this quiet connector hall as a study area. It links the Bauer Family Academic Center and Koessler Administration Building and doubles as a lobby for the Kavinoky Theatre.
cards.short_summary: A study space located in the hall connecting BFAC and KAB.
cards.evidence_claim: Joan of Arc Hall, which connects BFAC and KAB, serves as both a study space and the Kavinoky's lobby.
cards.source_title: Annual Security and Fire Safety Report 2021
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours.

cards.title: IT Pulse Center & Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: First Floor of Bauer Family Academic Center
cards.notes: Located on the first floor of BFAC, this lounge provides workstations and study spaces. It is the go-to spot for students needing technical assistance while they work.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused study lounge on the first floor of the BFAC building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Lounge, located on the first floor of the Bauer Family Academic Center, includes study spaces and workstations.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

cards.title: Madonna Lounge
cards.subtitle: First Floor Active Learning Center
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of Madonna Hall to find the Madonna Lounge and Active Learning Center. This space is designed for modern, interactive study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An active learning center and lounge located on the first floor of Madonna Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: A futuristic Active Learning Center and Madonna Lounge are located on the 1st floor of Madonna Hall.
cards.source_title: Annual Security and Fire Safety Report 2021
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: DAC 6th Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Top Floor Views at the DAC
cards.notes: Head to the top floor of the D'Youville Academic Center for a quiet study environment. The DAC is known for its numerous classrooms and dedicated study spaces throughout.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area located on the 6th floor of the D'Youville Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Floor is the top floor of DAC, which is noted for containing technology centers and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours.

cards.title: Maggie's Café Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Lower Level of the ALT Building
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie and find a table in the lower level of the Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building. This spot offers plenty of seating and is perfect for casual studying between classes.
cards.short_summary: A dining and study area located in the basement of the ALT building.
cards.evidence_claim: Maggie's Cafe is situated in the basement of the ALT building and features space for studying and socializing.
cards.access_notes: Open during dining hours; typically weekdays 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

cards.title: Container Park Outdoor Study
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Space Outside the DAC
cards.notes: When the weather is nice, head to the Container Park outside the DAC. It's a great spot for catching up on studies in an open-air environment when no events are scheduled.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor social and study space located adjacent to the D'Youville Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Container Park, located outside the DAC, is a great space for socialization or catching up on studies when there are no concerts.
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; best used during daylight hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the immediate blocks and corridors surrounding D'Youville University's West Side campus, featuring academic hubs, athletic fields, and community landmarks.

cards.title: The Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Porter Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the heart of campus to start a tour or meet with admissions. This historic building serves as the primary administrative hub for the university.
cards.short_summary: The central administrative building and primary visitor starting point on Porter Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Most tours and admissions events begin at the Koessler Administration Building (KAB), located at 320 Porter Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard university business hours; visitor parking is available directly in front.

cards.title: Community Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Connecticut Street
cards.notes: Access primary care, a public pharmacy, and a neighborhood cafe in this state-of-the-art facility designed for interprofessional education.
cards.short_summary: A 57,000-square-foot health facility offering medical services and student training on Connecticut Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Professions Hub is located at 301 Connecticut Street and includes a pharmacy, clinic, and demonstration kitchen.
cards.access_notes: The building is open to the public; specific clinic and pharmacy hours vary.

cards.title: Academic Innovation Hub
cards.subtitle: Niagara Street
cards.notes: Study in modern labs and smart classrooms within this renovated historic landmark that houses the School of Arts, Sciences and Education.
cards.short_summary: A $26.7 million academic facility featuring research labs and a student cafe on Niagara Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dr. Charles and Mary Schweitzer Bauer School of Arts, Sciences and Education Building is located at 605 Niagara Street.
cards.source_title: The School of Arts, Sciences and Education Opens $26.7 Million Facility | D'Youville
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students and faculty with university ID; public access for specific events.

cards.title: Historic Performance Space
cards.subtitle: Prospect Avenue
cards.notes: Attend a professional theater production in this intimate 250-seat Victorian-style auditorium known for its rococo architecture.
cards.short_summary: An award-winning professional theater located within the D'Youville campus on Prospect Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kavinoky Theatre's main entrance is on Prospect Avenue, housed in a Victorian-style auditorium.
cards.source_title: Who We Are — D'Youville Kavinoky Theatre
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled performances; accessible entrance via Parking Lot A off Fargo Avenue.

cards.title: Saints Athletic Complex
cards.subtitle: Fourth Street
cards.notes: Watch the Saints compete in soccer, lacrosse, or softball at this $5.5 million lighted turf athletic complex near the waterfront.
cards.short_summary: The primary outdoor athletic facility for D'Youville University sports on Fourth Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Dobson Field is located at 602 Fourth Street and serves as the home for soccer, lacrosse, and softball.
cards.access_notes: Open for university athletic events and scheduled rentals.

cards.title: Modern Campus Living
cards.subtitle: West Avenue
cards.notes: Live in fully furnished quad or double apartments featuring a recreation area and resident-only gated parking.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated residential complex for D'Youville students located on West Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Apartment Complex is located at 222 West Avenue and features fully furnished apartments.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents and authorized guests; electronic access cards required.

cards.title: Visitor Parking Hub
cards.subtitle: Fargo Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the primary visitor parking area for the Kavinoky Theatre and campus events located off this neighborhood traffic circle.
cards.short_summary: A key campus access point and parking area located on Fargo Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Lot A, which has dedicated parking spots for visitor parking, is located off the Fargo Avenue Circle.
cards.access_notes: Visitor parking available; permit required for student and faculty spots.

cards.title: Indoor Athletics Hub
cards.subtitle: Porter Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the university's main gymnasium for indoor sports and recreational activities, originally established in 1969.
cards.short_summary: The primary indoor athletic and recreational facility located on Porter Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saints Center Gym is located at 329 Porter Avenue.
cards.source_title: Saints Center - Facilities - D'Youville University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open for university athletic events and student recreation.

cards.title: Saints Gear & Supplies
cards.subtitle: Prospect Avenue
cards.notes: Purchase university apparel, textbooks, and school supplies at the official campus retail location.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore and retail shop located on Prospect Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The D'Youville University Campus Store is located at 569 Prospect Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during standard retail hours.

cards.title: Administrative Annex
cards.subtitle: Jersey Street
cards.notes: Find various university offices including Alumni Association and Human Resources in this block near the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A university-owned complex housing administrative and alumni offices near Jersey Street.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Youville owns buildings at 605 and 631 Niagara Street, encompassing a portion of the block on Jersey Street.
cards.source_title: D'Youville Purchases Former Gateway-Longview Building | D'Youville
cards.access_notes: Administrative offices; open during university business hours.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the Saint experience at D'Youville University, from historic processions to modern record-breaking feats.

cards.title: Redfest
cards.subtitle: Annual Fall Music Festival
cards.notes: Join the campus community at Buffalo RiverWorks for this massive fall concert featuring live DJs and student celebrations.
cards.short_summary: Redfest is D'Youville's signature fall music festival and semester-opening celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Redfest is described as one of the biggest celebrations of the year, held annually at Buffalo RiverWorks for students, staff, and alumni.
cards.access_notes: Open to the D'Youville community; registration is typically required for the off-campus venue.

cards.title: Commencement Foot Clapping
cards.subtitle: Guinness World Record Tradition
cards.notes: Participate in the university's unique tradition of foot clapping during commencement, a practice that set a world record in 2026.
cards.short_summary: D'Youville graduates celebrate their commencement by participating in a mass foot-clapping ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Youville officially set a GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most people simultaneously foot clapping with 524 participants during the 2026 commencement.
cards.source_title: D'Youville University Celebrates Class of 2026 with Record-Setting Commencement Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Occurs during the annual spring commencement ceremony at the Harborcenter.

cards.title: Feast of Saint Marguerite d'Youville
cards.subtitle: Founder's Day Celebration
cards.notes: Honor the university's namesake every October 16th with campus-wide events reflecting the mission of the Grey Nuns.
cards.short_summary: The Feast Day of Saint Marguerite d'Youville is an annual observance of the university's patron saint.
cards.evidence_claim: The university recognizes Saint Marguerite d'Youville's Feast Day on October 16 with events honoring her legacy and the school's namesake.
cards.source_title: What's in a Name: The Story of Marie-Marguerite d'Youville
cards.access_notes: Campus-wide events are held annually in mid-October.

cards.title: Baccalaureate Procession
cards.subtitle: Historic Academic March
cards.notes: Watch the colorful procession of faculty and graduates in full regalia as they march from the Administration Building to the church.
cards.short_summary: The Baccalaureate and Hooding Ceremony features a traditional academic march through the campus streets.
cards.evidence_claim: The ceremony features graduating students and faculty in full academic regalia marching from the Koessler Administration Building to Holy Angels Church.
cards.source_title: Traditional D'Youville Baccalaureate Ceremony Set for Friday, May 19
cards.access_notes: Held the day before commencement; the procession is visible along Porter Avenue.

cards.title: White Coat Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Healthcare Professional Rite of Passage
cards.notes: Witness the moment pharmacy and medical students receive their first white coats, symbolizing their entry into the profession.
cards.short_summary: D'Youville's health profession schools hold annual ceremonies to vest students in their professional white coats.
cards.evidence_claim: The D'Youville School of Pharmacy and College of Osteopathic Medicine host annual White Coat Ceremonies for their students.
cards.access_notes: Attendance is mandatory for students in the program; families are invited to attend.

cards.title: Maggie and Saint
cards.subtitle: Live Mascot Tradition
cards.notes: Meet the university's live Saint Bernard mascots, Maggie and Saint, who attend campus events and spread school spirit.
cards.short_summary: D'Youville maintains a tradition of having live Saint Bernard dogs as campus mascots and ambassadors.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Youville welcomed two Saint Bernard puppies, Maggie and Saint, to live on campus and support students as part of the new 'Saints' identity.
cards.source_title: We are the Saints - D'Youville University Athletics
cards.access_notes: The dogs can be found at the College Center and Koessler Administration Building during the day.

cards.title: Kavinoky Theatre Opening Night
cards.subtitle: Professional Theatre Tradition
cards.notes: Experience professional live theatre in a restored Edwardian recital hall right on the university campus.
cards.short_summary: The Kavinoky Theatre is a professional company in residence at D'Youville with a decades-long history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kavinoky Theatre has been producing plays since the 1970s and is housed in a restored 1903 Edwardian theater on campus.
cards.source_title: Who We Are — D'Youville Kavinoky Theatre
cards.access_notes: Performances are scheduled throughout the academic year; tickets are required.

cards.title: TGIF (Thank Goodness I'm Finished)
cards.subtitle: Pre-Commencement Celebration
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of your studies with bumper cars, food, and games during this festive night for graduates and families.
cards.short_summary: TGIF is a celebratory event held for graduating seniors the night before commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: The TGIF event takes place in the College Center gym featuring music, games, and a bumper car course for students and families.
cards.source_title: Relive: Lead-up to Graduation | D'Youville University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May for the graduating class.

cards.title: Senior Sunset Cruise
cards.subtitle: Niagara River Tradition
cards.notes: Board the Miss Buffalo for a sunset dinner cruise along the Niagara River as a final farewell for the senior class.
cards.short_summary: Graduating seniors participate in a traditional sunset cruise on the Niagara River during graduation week.
cards.evidence_claim: Seniors are treated to a Miss Buffalo Cruise with dinner and a sunset over the water as part of the lead-up to commencement.
cards.source_title: Relive: Lead-up to Graduation | D'Youville University
cards.access_notes: Typically held in mid-May; departs from the Buffalo waterfront.

cards.title: Taps 'n Caps
cards.subtitle: Cap Decorating Social
cards.notes: Gather with faculty and staff to decorate your graduation mortarboard while relaxing before the big weekend.
cards.short_summary: Taps 'n Caps is a social event where students decorate their graduation caps in a relaxed setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taps 'n Caps event allows students to relax with faculty and staff while decorating their graduation caps.
cards.source_title: Relive: Lead-up to Graduation | D'Youville University
cards.access_notes: Held at a local venue or on campus during graduation week.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at D'Youville University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide for new Saints to navigate their first weekend on the West Side, from historic campus landmarks to modern wellness spaces.

cards.title: Move-In and Floor Meetings
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Start your journey by moving into your residence hall. Attend the mandatory floor meetings in the evening to meet your RAs and neighbors.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the residential experience for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in for the 2025 orientation was scheduled for Wednesday morning, followed by residence hall floor meetings at 8:45 PM.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residential students during move-in hours.

cards.title: The Dinking Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A Saintly Tradition
cards.notes: Participate in this signature D'Youville tradition where new students are officially welcomed into the university community.
cards.short_summary: A formal induction ceremony for new students held in the campus gymnasium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dinking Ceremony is a scheduled event during orientation, typically held in the Saints Center Gym.
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students during orientation.

cards.title: First Meal at Kuhrt
cards.subtitle: Campus Dining Hub
cards.notes: Head to the Saints Center for your first campus meal. This food-court style hall offers a variety of hot and cold options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for D'Youville students located in the Saints Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Kuhrt Dining Hall is located in the Saints Center and serves as the main choice for student meals.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check university schedule for specific weekend brunch hours.

cards.title: Explore the Kavinoky
cards.subtitle: Historic Edwardian Gem
cards.notes: Visit this professional theatre housed in the Koessler Administration Building. It features stunning rococo architecture and a 250-seat auditorium.
cards.short_summary: A historic, professional theatre located on the D'Youville campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kavinoky Theatre is a Victorian-style auditorium located within the Koessler Administration Building.
cards.source_title: Who We Are — D'Youville Kavinoky Theatre
cards.access_notes: Public access for shows; students often attend orientation lectures here.

cards.title: The Hub Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern Campus Gateway
cards.notes: Walk through the 'Main Street' atrium of this $27 million facility. Check out the public art murals and the D'Lish demonstration kitchen.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art community health and education center on the West Side.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Professions Hub features an atrium that serves as a 'main street' and includes public art and a demonstration kitchen.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public during business hours.

cards.title: Weekend Workout
cards.subtitle: Sixth Floor Views
cards.notes: Visit the fitness center on the 6th floor for cardio with a view. Use your student ID for free access to treadmills and weights.
cards.short_summary: The campus fitness facility located within the D'Youville Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center is located on the sixth floor of the D'Youville Academic Center and is open Saturdays and Sundays from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM - 7 PM on weekends; valid student ID required.

cards.title: Coffee at Maggie's
cards.subtitle: ALT Building Social Spot
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie or sandwich in the lower level of the ALT building. It's a popular spot to relax and hang out with new friends.
cards.short_summary: A student cafe and social space located in the Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Maggie's Café is located in the lower level of the ALT building and offers sandwiches, smoothies, and outdoor dining.
cards.access_notes: Check weekend hours; typically open during academic sessions.

cards.title: Study Session at Montante
cards.subtitle: Quiet Campus Retreat
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner in the library to review your first-week syllabus. Use the computer labs or browse the university archives.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library for D'Youville University.
cards.evidence_claim: The Montante Family Library is the primary library on campus and includes study spaces and computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Open to students; check library website for specific weekend hours.

cards.title: Saints Game Day
cards.subtitle: Athletic Complex
cards.notes: Catch a soccer or lacrosse game at Dobson Field. Students get free admission to all home games with a valid university ID.
cards.short_summary: The home field for D'Youville's outdoor athletic programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Dobson Field is located at Porter Avenue and Fourth St. and offers free admission to students with ID.
cards.access_notes: Open during scheduled athletic events.

cards.title: Sunday Reset
cards.subtitle: KAB Third Floor
cards.notes: End your weekend with a visit to the Wellness Lodge for yoga or meditation. It's a dedicated space for students to relax and reset.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student wellness space located in the historic Koessler Administration Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Lodge is located on the 3rd floor of KAB and hosts events like yoga and meditation.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled wellness sessions and student relaxation.
